purpose: Defines how documents in a parallel state during additive development are mechanically identified and communicated to spec appliers, and how old-spec content is treated.
summary: Old spec documents are not rewritten until implementation completes, creating parallel old and new specs
Rationale: appliers cannot tell missing notice from absence of parallel documents
Glossary: parallel state, old spec, spec applier, implementer
Table of appliers and whether notification is realized: implementation, review, upstream generation, merge
FNC-001 machine-readable identifier present only during parallel state; plans carry none
FNC-002 identification result carries state only, not actions
FNC-003 appliers are informed before judgment, including when none exist
FNC-004 old-spec text is not the current spec in the covered scope
FNC-005 identification failure is not treated as not-parallel
tasks: Writing requirements or designs as additive features
Generating upstream documents from existing specs
Merging parallel documents into old specs
title: REQ-025 差分開発の仕組み 要件定義書
